assessment.why: Elon's admitted recovered-original placement, admitted target-glass handling and desire for Grant's trustee place form the strongest causal circumstantial case. His mistaken-copy explanation and an unidentified miniature leave reasonable alternatives; this is not conclusive.

plausibility_notes: Multiple suspects saying death would not erase obligations is motive clarification, not innocence proof.
No continuous glass coverage, named miniature recipient, or theft eyewitness establishes an exclusive route.
The fresh neck damage would make Elon's failure to inspect an ordinary possible mistake, although suspicious in context.
